items.title: Pay invoice for built-in shelf
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug auf unser Konto (IBAN siehe unten).
items.computation: The invoice date (30.01.2026) is the triggering event; under §187 Abs. 1 BGB that day is not counted, so the one-month period runs from 31.01.2026. Under §188 Abs. 2 BGB a monthly period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the event day, i.e. the 30th of February. February 2026 has only 28 days, so under §188 Abs. 3 BGB the period ends on the last day of that month: Saturday, 28.02.2026. As this is a private payment obligation, §193 BGB applies: since the last day is a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next business day. Sunday 01.03.2026 is not a business day either, so the deadline moves to Monday, 02.03.2026, which is not a public holiday in NW.
